Hello, and welcome back to Safe Online! I am Ryan. Is your computer slow? Does it freeze? Do not worry. Today I have three easy fixes. Fix number one: restart your computer. Many problems stop after a restart. Fix number two: check your Wi-Fi. If the internet is slow, turn the router off and on again. Fix number three: look at the error message. Write it down, and look for it online. And if your computer does not turn on, check the battery and the charger. If it is still broken, call a technician. See you next Monday!

Hello, this is Maria from TechStore support, with a message for Estephano Ishii. Thank you for your call this morning. We have news about your ByteBook 14. The battery is broken, and that is why the laptop does not turn on. Good news: your laptop is new, so we fix it for free. The new battery arrives on Thursday, and your laptop is ready on Friday afternoon. You can pick it up at our store on Paulista Avenue. If you have a question, please call us. Thank you, and have a nice day!
